Coffee & food

What is on the counter

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Specialty coffee

Two roasts to choose from, medium and fruity or dark and chocolatey, for flat white, cappuccino or an iced latte with homemade amaretto syrup.

Homemade cakes

Cakes, cookies and pastries from their own oven, like cinnamon roll cake, Japanese cheesecake and vegan cakes. Syrups are made in house too.

Breakfast and sandwiches

Granola, a salmon sandwich, a cheese and fig sandwich and Lebanese dishes like kunafah, as guests describe them.

Inside or in the courtyard

Air conditioning inside, shade and fans in the courtyard, and several guests write that it is good for working on a laptop.

The place

Photos from Bardo’s Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

The courtyard

At least 30 reviews mention the courtyard, garden or terrace at the back.

The welcome

Guests write that the owners suggest coffees to their taste and remember what they like. English, Greek, Spanish and Arabic are spoken.

Open on Sundays

Sunday 9:00-14:00, and one guest calls them the specialty coffee savior when everyone else is closed.

A café in the old town

Bardo sits in an old house on Constantinou Kalogera, 30 seconds from the Church of Saint Lazarus, with orange doors at the front and a courtyard with trees and a striped awning at the back. Reviews come in English, Greek, German, Russian, Spanish and Ukrainian, and many call it the best coffee in Larnaca.

What guests say

Three of 293 Google reviews, all three with five stars.

“I love everything about this place. The staff, the coffee, the garden, the homemade pastries! They make their own syrups and cakes from scratch. So much care is put into every single detail and it shows. The coffee is delicious. It feels like a really wholesome community. Highly recommend!”

Google review
„Eine echte Oase in der Altstadt von Larnaka. Die Betreiber sind sehr zuvorkommend. Sie servieren den besten Kaffee der Stadt! Sehr zu empfehlen: Der liebevoll hergerichtet Hinterhof!“

Google review
“Top Coffee! They offer two types of different bean roast, medium (more fruity) and dark roast (more chocolate). If you value good coffee, then you've come to the right place.”
